About Me

I'm an Electrical Engineer and Proposal & Estimation professional with over four years of experience across construction bidding, cost estimation, technical proposal development, and project coordination. I've worked on more than 1,000 projects and contributed to multimillion-dollar project wins, including a recent $4 million award.

At Decima LLC, I lead and mentor a team of 10 proposal engineers, coordinating bid strategy, drawing and specification reviews, pricing, and subcontractor engagement. I also develop practical digital tools for bid tracking, KPI management, performance reviews, and corrective actions. Alongside my career, I'm pursuing an MS in Electrical Engineering (Power) at NUST PNEC.
